nodes.label: build_demos CMake Function
nodes.rationale: Convenience function that compiles every name in a DEMOS list as <name>.cpp, sets the demos IDE folder, MSVC runtime library and debugger working directory, adds the chrono_thirdparty include path, links LIBS, and installs Release configurations to CH_INSTALL_DEMO.

nodes.label: Demo RPATH Policy
nodes.rationale: Full RPATH is used, differentiated between build and install trees, so demo binaries locate Chrono shared libraries both in-place and after installation; the install RPATH is only set when CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib is not already a system directory.

nodes.label: Module-Gated Demo Subdirectories
nodes.rationale: Each demo subdirectory is guarded by its module's CH_ENABLE_MODULE_* flag plus a per-group BUILD_DEMOS_* advanced option, so the demo tree tracks the enabled module set exactly; MBS demos require Irrlicht OR VSG, and vehicle demos additionally require CH_ENABLE_MODULE_VEHICLE_MODELS.

nodes.label: Csharp_demos Nested Sub-Build Target
nodes.rationale: C# demos are built by a custom target that invokes a fully separate CMake configure+build of demos/csharp, forwarding the enabled-module flags and CH_USE_CSHARP_WRAPPER so the sub-build knows whether to reference chrono_csharp_wrapper.dll or the raw .cs files. Ordering is enforced with add_dependencies on the SWIG-generated Chrono_csharp_* targets.
